name: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs, add cheese, and cook in a pan.

name: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta. Prepare a tomato sauce and mix them.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Chop the vegetables, beat the eggs, and cook everything in a pan.

name: Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Place cheese and sliced tomato between bread slices.

name: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook the chicken, chop the vegetables, and mix everything in a bowl.

name: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix crushed garlic with butter, spread on bread, and bake until golden.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients and cook small portions in a pan until golden.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Chop the vegetables, boil them in water, and cook until soft.

name: Chicken Rice
instructions: Cook the chicken and prepare rice with onion and butter.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop the vegetables and mix them with olives and feta cheese.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes, mash them, and mix with milk and butter.

name: Tuna Sandwich
instructions: Mix tuna with mayonnaise and place it between bread slices with lettuce.

name: Mushroom Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta and prepare a creamy mushroom sauce with garlic.

name: Fruit Salad
instructions: Wash and chop all fruits, then mix them in a bowl.

name: Tomato Soup
instructions: Cook tomatoes with onion and garlic, add water, and blend until smooth.

name: Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice, fry the vegetables and egg, then mix everything with soy sauce.

name: Baked Potatoes
instructions: Cut the potatoes, season with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and bake until tender.

name: Banana Smoothie
instructions: Blend the banana, milk, and honey until smooth.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Boil lentils with chopped onion and carrot until soft, then blend.

name: Chicken Wrap
instructions: Cook the chicken, place it on a tortilla with vegetables, and roll it up.
